# P1-04 — Real adiabatic subtraction in M4

> **Addendum (W1 PHYS3, `build/w1-phys3`; see `evidence/W1-physics-3.md` and `lanes/W1-physics-3.md` → Routed).** Gap 2's "Making physical the default is blocked by P1-03 gap 2" is stale: Decision 11 made `physical` the default. After the M3 Bogoliubov fix, three things changed:
> - M4 divides by T_reh in M_Pl (it was in GeV).
> - M4 reports `normalisation_residual`, which is 9 today: ΔN_L ∝ a_end H_end.
> - `pipeline.eta_B_refusal` refuses η_B until P1-04 matches a to reheating so that residual is ≤ 5e-3.
>
> The ΔN_L figures quoted below (1.6e-58 starobinsky, 1.7e-63 natural, and "exactly 0 with schematic couplings") were computed with the defective extraction and GeV T_reh, so they no longer apply.

Status: **OPEN-WITH-GAP**. The quadrature cross-check is done; the 4th-order adiabatic subtraction and the V4 cross-check are not.

## Done: quadrature cross-check (`m4_anomaly/anomaly.py`)
- **`quad_cross_check(log_k, per_mode)`** integrates M4's k-integrand (the same piecewise-linear interpolant) with `mpmath.quad` at **dps 30**, split at every node, and with `scipy.integrate.quad` (node breakpoints, epsrel 1e-13). It returns the relative disagreement and **flags it above 1e-8** (`QUAD_FLAG_THRESHOLD`).
- **`AnomalyResult`** gains `quad_rel_disagreement` and `quad_flag`. Every pipeline run reports them.
- **Measured:** starobinsky and natural audit configs, schematic and physical couplings: `quad_rel_disagreement = 0.0`, flag False.
- **Tests:** `backend/tests/unit/test_m4_quad_cross_check.py`, 3 passed. They cover a smooth integrand, exactness on piecewise-linear data, and the pipeline reporting the check.

## Not done: the measured gap
1. **4th-order adiabatic subtraction (Kamada et al., arXiv:2007.08029).**
   - Not implemented. arXiv is unreachable from the build sandbox, so the paper's equations (2.14–2.18, cited in `anomaly.py`) can't be checked.
   - M4's integrand is also the Bogoliubov difference k(|β₊|² − |β₋|²) in M3's Minkowski/WKB basis. The 4th-order counterterms of an adiabatic scheme subtract the vacuum part 1/(2W_λ) of |h_λ|², which this representation never forms. Implementing the subtraction honestly needs M4 to integrate |h_λ|², |h′_λ|² with the GR −a″/a term in M3, the same basis work as P1-03 gap 3.
   - `_adiabatic_subtraction` is unchanged: zero, with its existing docstring.
2. **"Use M1's a(τ)".** M1 (P1-01) covers the post-inflation background, while M4's τ grid is inflationary.
   - Under `coupling_model="physical"`, M4 now uses a(τ) from the same inflaton trajectory as M3 (P1-03).
   - The default schematic model keeps a = 1/|τ|. Making physical the default is blocked by P1-03 gap 2.
3. **V4 cross-check (arXiv:2412.09490, Eqs. 7–16), within the run's uncertainty budget.**
   - Not achievable yet. `_v4_cross_check` returns an un-normalised indicator, and arXiv:2412.09490 is unreachable.
   - On the audit configs ΔN_L is exactly 0 with schematic couplings: θ_grav/f_a ~ 1e-20 generates no asymmetry. With physical couplings it is 1.6e-58 (starobinsky) and 1.7e-63 (natural). A V4 comparison needs the normalised formula.

## 2026-11-02, lane P1-04 (`build/w1-p104`, from `build/w1-api3` @ `0c4848f`)

Status: **DONE** under the ticket's done-when: the V4 cross-check agrees within the run's uncertainty budget on the Kawai–Kim configuration. η_B is still **not computable**: it is refused on the UV band (below). Lane notes, with decisions, corrected tests and routing: `docs/build/lanes/W1-p104.md`.

Papers: arXiv:2007.08029 (V3), arXiv:2412.09490 (V4) and arXiv:1702.07689, PDF and TeX source fetched from arxiv.org. This supersedes gaps 1–3 of the section above.

### What was built
- `backend/src/ucgle_f1/m4_anomaly/adiabatic.py`: V3's adiabatic expansion (Eqs. 3.15–3.20, strict, any even order), with the Eq. 3.17 𝒥 integrand as an exact Laurent polynomial in k. Gauss–Bonnet δ_T and Δ are included.
- `backend/src/ucgle_f1/m4_anomaly/physical.py`:
  - canonical tensor modes (V3 Eq. 2.14 + GB sound speed, a″/a included) on M2's full trajectory, from V3's adiabatic vacuum (Eq. 3.14) at k/(aH) = 100;
  - first-order CS linear response;
  - n_L from V3 Eqs. 2.24/2.28/2.29 with the fourth-order subtraction;
  - Y_L = n_L T_reh/(4H_end²);
  - the V4 Eq. 7 boundary form as the cross-check.
- `m4_anomaly/anomaly.py` routes the pipeline's physical coupling model to it, via `AnomalyInputs.background` = `CouplingProfile.arrays`, a new additive field. The schematic model keeps the legacy proxy, flagged unsubtracted.
- `m7_infer/pipeline.py::eta_B_refusal` gains three fail-closed conditions: V4 disagreement, parity zero, UV band.

- V4 agreement: 1.4e-9 at `fast` and 2.4e-9 at `standard`, i.e. 1.8e6× and 1.0e6× inside the run's 2.45e-3 budget.
- **`high`** (64 modes, k ∈ [1e-3, 1e3], so the band reaches the end-of-inflation horizon scale; M3 1478 s with its pre-existing mpmath escalation, M4 43 s):
  - Y_L = −4.1470689e-39, ΔQ_A(V4) = −4.1470688e-39, V4 disagreement 9.7e-9 (budget 2.45e-3);
  - normalisation residual 1.3e-8, start-time sensitivity 1.1e-6, quad 1.1e-16 (flag False);
  - UV share **0.321**: refused;
  - raw η_B −2.09e-40;
  - S1 PASS_P, S5 PASS_S, S6 PASS_S, S8/S14 FAIL (refused).
- On `0c4848f` (same config, `git archive`) the raw η_B was −6.157, and S5/S6 were FAIL (4.9e-13 / 1.48e-3). On this branch they are PASS_S (0.99999999882) / PASS_P (3.8e-7). Every other S-verdict is unchanged, so the adapter snapshot's `audit_passed` goes 10 → 12.
- **Is η_B computable?** No. Budget (2.45e-3), normalisation residual (8e-10) and V4 (1.4e-9) are all inside 0.5 %, but n_L is dominated by the UV end of the run's band (84 % from the last interval at `fast`).
  - The band lies outside the horizon at the end of inflation: k/(a_end H_end) = 1e-4 to 1e-2 at `fast`. There the fourth-order counterterm is 2e-7 to 4e-5 of the exact bracket (k = 0.1: S = 1.75e-17, S^ad = −3.3e-24; k = 10: 7.6e-18 vs −3.3e-22), and k³S still grows.
  - Extending the band to k = a_end H_end = 10³ (13 modes) gives Y_L = −4.57e-39 (×7e4), V4 2.6e-8, and the last-interval share is still 0.76.
  - Past that scale the modes are inside the horizon, where V3 Eq. 3.21 leaves Λ² and ln Λ after fourth order.
- **Paper-valued CS coupling** (θ_grav/f̂_a = γ/2 = 0.5, Kawai–Kim's γ = 1, otherwise the fixture config, `fast` band): Y_L = −1.66e-46, V4 1.4e-9, UV share 0.838.

### Analytic checks
- **V3 Eq. 3.21, order by order** (de Sitter, Θ = 1e-8, physical cutoffs c < k/a < Λ). Order 4 gives a³H⁵κ̃/π²·(Λ⁴ − c⁴), order 6 adds 3(Λ² − c²), order 8 adds −10 ln(Λ/c). Each holds to rel 1e-9 at Λ/H ∈ {30, 100}, η ∈ {−1, −0.37}.
- **De Sitter Bunch–Davies.** 1/Ω^(order 6) = (1 + 1/(kη)²)/k up to O((kη)⁻⁶). The mode solver gives |h|² = 2H²/k³(1 + (kτ)²) (rel 1e-6).
- **Other limits.** Radiation era Ω = k at every order. Constant sound speed Ω = k√(1+C). GB parity-even, CS parity-odd.
- **V4's own mode model** (Eqs. 9–11). M4's Eq. 7 integrand reproduces Eq. 13, −(πβ_s/a_in)²|h_s(τ_0)|², to rel 1e-12, and the Eq. 15 helicity factor 2b_χ + (1 + b_χ²)χ to rel 1e-9.
- **De Sitter end to end** (241 modes, k/aH ≤ 30, rtol 1e-10). The order-4-subtracted per-mode source tends to a³H⁵κ̃/π²(6k² − 10) with remainder ≲ 65/k². The band gives 𝒥_sub(Λ) = 3Λ² − 10 ln Λ + 6.58, against V3 Eq. 3.13's 39/2 − 10γ − 10 ln 2 = 6.80 (3 %; the finite part is vacuum-dependent, V3 Sec. 3.1).

### Tests added
- `backend/tests/unit/test_m4_adiabatic.py`, 14 tests. V3 Eq. 3.21 order by order; de Sitter Bunch–Davies; radiation; constant sound speed; parity; exact k-integral; order validation.
- `backend/tests/unit/test_m4_physical.py`, 13 tests:
  - the V4 cross-check on the Kawai–Kim configuration (V3 Eq. 2.24 vs V4 Eq. 7, within `_budget_total`);
  - Y_L = n_L T_reh/(4H_end²);
  - ΔN_L invariance under a → c·a, k → c·k, τ → τ/c for c ∈ {0.1, 10}, via both the probe and the end-to-end `coupling_profile(a_end_H_end = c·A_END_H_END)`;
  - the pipeline normalisation residual ≤ 1e-6;
  - the parity flip, and θ_grav = 0 ⇒ exactly 0;
  - start independence (x = 100 vs 200);
  - the de Sitter |h|² → 2H²/k³ limit;
  - the de Sitter UV tail 6k² − 10;
  - a trajectory too short for M4's adiabatic start degrades (NaN, `physical_error`, η_B refused) instead of crashing, at unit level and end to end (φ₀ = 6.5, 11.1 e-folds).
- `backend/tests/unit/test_m4_v4.py`, 19 tests. V4 Eqs. 9–13 and the Eq. 15 helicity factor on V4's own modes; the linearised helicity sum is the exact odd part.
- mpmath-vs-scipy: the existing `test_m4_quad_cross_check.py` (3 tests) now runs on the physical integrand. The pipeline reports `quad_rel_disagreement` 1.1e-16 with the flag False (threshold 1e-8).
- Corrected tests (old → new, with proof): `docs/build/lanes/W1-p104.md`.
